information.description:
Among the rarest of scavs are these chromed-out hunters that love the sound of their heavy-caliber rifle. Unlike the riff-raff they tend to lord over, Scavenger snipers are a threat to stay wary of and to avoid whenever possible, as they’re used to stalking prey for possibly hours before making a critical strike and are unlikely to miss. Yet, if you can catch them between shots and hit ‘em back just as hard, you might have a chance.

From Corgo's 77 Collection: Mooks by Corgopolis (Scavengers).

description.value: Experts in combat who use their fighting prowess to dominate in the lawless time of the Red.

Unity is often sought after, but difficult to achieve. After all, Night City is a city of individualists, anarchists and warring gangs. To unite under a shared banner, you'll need a persuasive argument – preferably cast from lead. The designers responsible for the Unity understood this well. This universal, inexpensive pistol has resolved countless conflicts and put a stop to disputes. Dissatisfied customers, betrayed spouses, impatient drivers stuck in traffic – chances are they'll pull out a Unity.

Cost: 250eb (Premium)

Class: Heavy Pistol • Skill: Handgun • Range: Pistol

Damage: 3d6 • Capacity: 12 • ROF: 2 • Hands: 1

Alt. Firing Modes: None

Concealable: Yes

Slots: 3 • Attachments: None • Mods: None

Special Features: When using this weapon to make an Aimed Shot, it deals 1d6 additional damage (4d6).

Range: Pistol

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog).

Around the turn of the 21st century, the arms industry faced a pressing challenge. Many popular sniper rifles were increasingly proving ineffective against people heavily modified with cyberware. A shot that would once kill an ordinary person now only makes a dent. The world required a new generation of sniper rifles. The first of this new wave was the Soviet-made SPT-32 Grad, considered by many to be the most powerful sniper on the market. It may not possess the same detail as its counterparts from Arasaka or Militech, but in the hands of a well-trained sharpshooter, the Grad is a true devastating force.

Cost: 1,000eb (Very Expensive)

Class: EQ Sniper Rifle • Skill: Heavy Weapons • Range: Anti-Material Rifle

Damage: 6d6 • Capacity: 4 • ROF: 1 • Hands: 2

Originally intended for special operations use, this quickly-abandoned implant enables projecting a one-way holographic mask over the user’s face, entirely obscuring it while still providing full vision.

External Body Cyberware. While active, this cyberware masks the user's face from external sources, including cameras. Anyone attempting a Human Perception or Lip Reading check against users with this cyberware active takes a -2 penalty to their check. Counts as an instance of Gang Colors Jewelry for Scavengers, if tweaked to the right display setting. Turning this cyberware on or off takes an Action. NOTE: This is the digital facemask that Scavs use in 2077. The World of 2077 book specifically mentions “K.E.R.S” for the Scavengers, so that’s what this was inspired by.

Type: External Body Cyberware
Install: Mall
Option Slots: uses 1

Foundry notes:

  • The -2 applies to other people's checks, so it can't be automated from this item.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Cyberware > External Body Cyberware).
